name: TraceForge
description: Signal paths, PCB tools and deterministic manufacturing packages for KiCad 10
description_full: TraceForge combines signal path timing, trace cleanup, rounded track corners, exact-angle component rotation, via stitching, via array placement, via-size filtering and DRC-tested enlargement, RF via fencing, BGA fanout and live net visualization in one PCB Editor panel. The Manufacturing tab reviews saved projects, runs KiCad checks and builds PCBWay or PCBPower deliverable packages from verified choices. Toolbar and Tools menu shortcuts open its feature tabs directly. PCB editing reads the live board through KiCad 10's pcbnew bindings. Manufacturing export uses kicad-cli and a separate Python with openpyxl. Supports Windows and KiCad 10 only. See the project homepage for documentation and known limits.
